decision_reason: The explicit compound allele is independently observed in Illumina and ONT RNA, passes the evidence gate, and yields a target-bearing peptide.
dna_only: Treating A>G alone predicts Lys-to-Arg. RNA carries the adjacent base change too, so the expressed AG>GT haplotype encodes serine.
interpretation: NTF3 is the cleanest RNA-versus-single-edit correction: the amino acid changes because the true local haplotype spans two adjacent bases.
limitation: osteosarc.com lists p.Lys69Ser but does not currently publish a protein context; the displayed window comes from the RNA reconstruction.
osteosarc_sequence_status: The variants table annotates p.Lys69Ser; the page does not publish a protein sequence context.

rna_evidence.counts_text: 4 ALT templates and 4 REF templates in the selected Illumina reconstruction

summary_rna: Illumina and ONT reproduce AG>GT; single-edit Lys→Arg is rejected
title: NTF3 compound p.Lys69Ser haplotype
variant_class: RNA correction of isolated SNV effect
